map.产程曲线（宫颈扩张）：按初产/经产与 ACOG 标准判定活跃期起点（宫口 6cm: Cervical-dilation curve: by parity and ACOG, set active-phase onset (6 or 4 cm); nulliparous latent cap 20h, multiparous 14h, to judge progress/arrest.
map.S形曲线：潜伏期(缓慢) → 活跃期(加速) → 减速期 → 第二产程: S-shaped: latent (slow) -> active (accelerating) -> deceleration -> second stage
map.超过上述时限为潜伏期延长: Exceeding the above is prolonged latent phase
map.宫口扩张<1cm/h×4h为活跃期延长: Dilation <1 cm/h x4h = prolonged active phase
map.宫口≥6cm+破膜后4h无进展: Dilation >=6 cm + no progress 4h after ROM
map.注：ACOG(2014)将活跃期起点从4cm改为6cm，6cm前不应诊断活跃期停: Note: ACOG (2014) moved active-phase onset from 4 to 6 cm; arrest should not be diagnosed before 6 cm.
map.提示：产程图是识别难产的重要工具。现代指南(ACOG/WHO)强调6cm为活跃期: Tip: the labor curve is key to identifying dystocia. Modern guidelines (ACOG/WHO) emphasize 6 cm as active onset to avoid premature intervention. This is a simulation reference; real assessment needs contractions, FHR, fetal position, etc.

map.产时绘制宫口扩张曲线，识别活跃期停滞。: Plot dilation curve intrapartum; identify active-phase arrest.
map.评估潜伏期与活跃期时长是否异常。: Assess whether latent/active durations are abnormal.
map.决定缩宫素加强或剖宫产指征。: Decide oxytocin augmentation or cesarean indication.
map.总产程 14h、潜伏期 8h，按活跃期后 4h 计第二产程：s2 = 14−8−: Total 14h, latent 8h, second stage = 14-8-4 = 2h; nulliparous second stage <=3h is normal.
map.活跃期宫口 4cm 后 4h 无进展（未达标 1.2cm/h），判活跃期停滞，需: Active phase: 4h no progress after 4 cm (<1.2 cm/h) = active arrest; assess cephalopelvic relation and consider intervention.
map.通常宫口 ≥4–6cm 进入活跃期，初产妇扩张速度 ≥1.2cm/h、经产妇 ≥: Usually dilation >=4-6 cm enters active phase; nulliparous >=1.2 cm/h, multiparous >=1.5 cm/h; below this with other abnormalities suggests arrest.
map.潜伏期多长算异常？: How long is the latent phase abnormal?
map.初产妇潜伏期 >20h、经产妇 >14h 为延长，需排查头盆不称与宫缩乏力。: Nulliparous latent >20h, multiparous >14h is prolonged; rule out cephalopelvic disproportion and inadequate contractions.
